2609.01318.title: Reliability Challenges in Diffusion Vision-Language Models
2609.01318.paper_summary: Diffusion-based Large Vision-Language Models (dLVLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) LVLMs, offering advantages in parallel decoding, bidirectional context, and controllable generation. Despite rapid progress, their reliability properties remain largely uncharacterized. We present the first systematic reliability evaluation of hallucination and bias in dLVLMs, benchmarking six diffusion models against competitive AR baselines across four dimensions. Our key findings are: (1) dLVLMs reverse the yes-bias of AR models in binary visual queries; (2) they achieve competitive hallucination rates yet exhibit degraded linguistic quality; (3) they collapse to near-zero accuracy on underrepresented racial groups with opposite-polarity gender bias; and (4) they exhibit accuracy collapse in multiple-choice settings when the correct option is shorter than its distractors, associated with a length prior that emerges at the first denoising step. Tokens committed at late denoising steps with low confidence further correlate with hallucinated content, pointing to a mechanistic signal unique to diffusion generation. These patterns vary across model families, suggesting reliability is shaped by the generative paradigm together with training data.
2609.01318.paper_summary_zh: 擴散基的大型視覺語言模型（dLVLMs）最近成為自回歸（AR）LVLMs 的一個引人注目的替代方案，提供了在平行解碼、雙向上下文和可控生成方面的優勢。儘管進展迅速，但它們的可靠性特性仍然在很大程度上未被特徵化。我們呈現了對 dLVLMs 中幻覺和偏見的首次系統性可靠性評估，將六個擴散模型與四個維度的競爭性 AR 基準進行基準測試。我們的主要發現是：（1）dLVLMs 逆轉了 AR 模型在二元視覺查詢中的是偏見；（2）它們達到了競爭性的幻覺率，但顯示出語言質量下降；（3）在與性別偏見相反極性的代表性不足的種族群體上，它們的準確率崩潰至接近零；（4）當正確選項比其干擾項短時，它們在多選設定中顯示出準確性崩潰，這與在第一個去噪步驟中出現的長度先驗有關。 在去噪步驟晚期以低信心承諾的標記進一步與幻覺內容相關，指向一個獨特於擴散生成的機制信號。這些模式在模型家族之間變化，表明可靠性是由生成範式與訓練數據共同塑造的。
2609.01318.author: Md. Atabuzzaman et.al.
